# 微软 FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）三大业务分部完整分析报告

## 一、口径提示（必读）

1. **分部与合计的勾稽关系**：三个分部（Productivity and Business Processes、Intelligent Cloud、More Personal Computing）的收入、成本、经营费用、经营利润加总后，与公司合计数**完全一致**（已逐项验证）。但"Microsoft Cloud"（$59.3B）是一个跨分部指标（涵盖 M365 Commercial、Azure、Dynamics 365、LinkedIn 商业部分等），**不可与任一单一部门直接相加或比较**，否则会重复计算。
2. **GAAP 口径**：本报告所有分部数字均为 GAAP 口径（未调整 OpenAI 投资影响）。OpenAI 投资影响仅体现在公司层面的 Other Income/Expense 和 Net Income 上，**分部经营利润不包含 OpenAI 调整**。FY26 Q4 OpenAI 对净利润的净影响为 +$480M（GAAP vs Non-GAAP）。
3. **同比基期**：所有 YoY 对比均为 FY26 Q4 vs FY25 Q4（同季度）。
4. **恒定汇率（Constant Currency）**：公司同时披露恒定汇率增速，差异主要来自汇率波动。报告以 GAAP 美元增速为主，重要处附注恒定汇率。
5. **"经营费用"口径**：微软分部表中的"Operating expenses"指 R&D + Sales & Marketing + G&A 的合计（不含 Cost of Revenue）。分部经营利润 = Revenue − Cost of Revenue − Operating expenses。
6. **数字单位**：除特别说明外，金额单位为百万美元（$M）。

---

## 二、公司整体概要

| 指标（$M） | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | YoY |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 90,007 | 76,441 | +17.7% |
| Cost of Revenue | 29,525 | 24,014 | +22.9% |
| Gross Margin | 60,482 | 52,427 | +15.4% |
| Gross Margin % | 67.2% | 68.6% | −1.4pp |
| Operating Expenses | 19,879 | 18,104 | +9.8% |
| Operating Income | 40,603 | 34,323 | +18.3% |
| Operating Margin | 45.1% | 44.9% | +0.2pp |
| Net Income | 35,766 | 27,233 | +31.3% |
| Diluted EPS | $4.81 | $3.65 | +31.8% |

**数据出处**：press_release.txt（"Microsoft Cloud and AI Strength Fuels Fourth Quarter Results"）+ financial_statements.txt → Income Statements 工作表 + Segment Results 工作表。

**驱动因素（电话会原文，Amy Hood 发言，transcript.txt 第 20000–22000 字符）**：
> "This quarter, revenue was $90 billion, up 18% and 17% in constant currency. Gross margin dollars increased 15% and operating income increased 18%."

毛利率同比下降的原因为：
> "Company gross margin percentage was 67%, down year-over-year, driven by sales mix shift to Azure as well as continued investments in AI infrastructure, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains, particularly in Azure and M365 Commercial cloud."

---

## 三、分部一：Productivity and Business Processes（生产力和业务流程）

### 3.1 财务数据（$M）

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | YoY（$） | YoY（%） |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 37,847 | 33,112 | +4,735 | +14.3% |
| Cost of Revenue | 6,989 | 6,042 | +947 | +15.7% |
| Gross Profit | 30,858 | 27,070 | +3,788 | +14.0% |
| Gross Margin % | 81.5% | 81.8% | — | −0.2pp |
| Operating Expenses | 8,958 | 8,077 | +881 | +10.9% |
| Operating Income | 21,900 | 18,993 | +2,907 | +15.3% |
| Operating Margin | 57.9% | 57.4% | — | +0.5pp |

**数据出处**：financial_statements.txt → Segment Results 工作表（Productivity and Business Processes 分部，第三、四列对应 FY26 Q4 / FY25 Q4）；增速与分部细节在 press_release.txt "Business Highlights" 段及 transcript.txt 第 22000–23000 字符（Amy Hood 段）。

### 3.2 增长驱动因素（电话会原文）

**M365 Commercial 云**（分部最大收入来源）：
> "M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. And on a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%."（transcript.txt 第 22000 字符，Amy Hood）

> "Building on our Copilot momentum from Q3, net paid seat adds more than doubled sequentially, with paid seats now over 30 million. Premium offerings, including Copilot, E5, and early traction in E7, drove ARPU growth this quarter. And paid M365 Commercial seats grew 6% year-over-year with installed base expansion across all customer segments, though primarily in our small and medium business and frontline worker offerings."（transcript.txt 第 22000–22200 字符）

> "M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."（transcript.txt）

**M365 Consumer 云**：
> "M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth. And M365 consumer subscriptions grew 7%."（transcript.txt）

**LinkedIn**：
> "LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."（transcript.txt）

**Dynamics 365**：
> "Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles."（transcript.txt）

### 3.3 利润率变化解读

分部经营利润率小幅提升 0.5pp（57.4% → 57.9%）。电话会解释：
> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 14% and 13% in constant currency. And gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage as we continue to invest in product quality and drive further efficiency gains. Operating expenses increased 11% primarily driven by the shared R&D investments mentioned earlier. Operating income increased 15% and 14% in constant currency. And operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%."（transcript.txt 第 22000–23000 字符）

即：毛利率因 Copilot 使用增加而略降，但经营费用增速（+11%）低于收入增速（+14%），规模效应推动经营利润率小幅扩张。

---

## 四、分部二：Intelligent Cloud（智能云）

### 4.1 财务数据（$M）

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | YoY（$） | YoY（%） |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 39,306 | 29,878 | +9,428 | +31.6% |
| Cost of Revenue | 16,876 | 11,845 | +5,031 | +42.5% |
| Gross Profit | 22,430 | 18,033 | +4,397 | +24.4% |
| Gross Margin % | 57.1% | 60.4% | — | −3.3pp |
| Operating Expenses | 6,475 | 5,893 | +582 | +9.9% |
| Operating Income | 15,955 | 12,140 | +3,815 | +31.4% |
| Operating Margin | 40.6% | 40.6% | — | ~0pp（持平） |

**数据出处**：financial_statements.txt → Segment Results 工作表（Intelligent Cloud 分部）。增速口径见 press_release.txt "Business Highlights" 段及 transcript.txt 第 23000–24000 字符。

### 4.2 增长驱动因素（电话会原文）

**Azure（分部核心增长引擎）**：
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."（transcript.txt 第 23000 字符，Amy Hood）

> "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."（transcript.txt）

**On-premises server**：
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."（transcript.txt）

> "This year, Azure revenue surpassed $100 billion for the first time"（Satya Nadella，transcript.txt 第 16000 字符）

### 4.3 利润率变化解读

- **毛利率下降 3.3pp（60.4% → 57.1%）**，为主要拖累项。原因：
> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."（transcript.txt）
- **经营费用仅 +9.9%**，显著低于收入增速（+31.6%），经营杠杆明显。
- **经营利润率持平于 40.6%**。电话会原文：
> "Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."（transcript.txt）

**关键观察**：Intelligent Cloud 是本季度收入增速最快（+31.6%）且绝对增量最大（+$9.4B）的分部，是公司整体增长的主引擎。AI 基础设施投入推升 COGS（+42.5%）快于收入（+31.6%），但规模效应与效率优化使经营利润率得以持平。

---

## 五、分部三：More Personal Computing（更多个人计算）

### 5.1 财务数据（$M）

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | YoY（$） | YoY（%） |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 12,854 | 13,451 | −597 | −4.4% |
| Cost of Revenue | 5,660 | 6,127 | −467 | −7.6% |
| Gross Profit | 7,194 | 7,324 | −130 | −1.8% |
| Gross Margin % | 56.0% | 54.4% | — | +1.5pp |
| Operating Expenses | 4,446 | 4,134 | +312 | +7.5% |
| Operating Income | 2,748 | 3,190 | −442 | −13.9% |
| Operating Margin | 21.4% | 23.7% | — | −2.3pp |

**数据出处**：financial_statements.txt → Segment Results 工作表（More Personal Computing 分部）；细节在 transcript.txt 第 24000–25000 字符（Amy Hood 段）。

### 5.2 下滑驱动因素（电话会原文）

**Windows OEM and Devices**：
> "Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support."（transcript.txt 第 24000 字符）

> "Results were ahead of expectations as OEM and channel partners continued to build inventory given increasing component prices."（transcript.txt）

**Search advertising（剔除 TAC）**：
> "Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."（transcript.txt）

**Xbox**：
> "And in XBOX, revenue decreased 10% and 11% in constant currency. XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance."（transcript.txt）

> "When it comes to XBOX, we are making the necessary decisions required across our content portfolio, platform, and operations to reset the business for long-term growth. We have the best IP in the industry, and talented studios around the world, and believe we can bring these strengths together and expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027."（Satya Nadella，transcript.txt 第 18000 字符）

### 5.3 利润率变化解读

- **毛利率反而提升 1.5pp（54.4% → 56.0%）**，原因：
> "Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition."（transcript.txt）
- **经营费用 +7.5%**，主要因共享 R&D 投入与 Xbox 减值：
> "Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX."（transcript.txt）
- **经营利润下降 13.9%，经营利润率下降 2.3pp 至 21%**：
> "Operating income decreased 14% and 15% in constant currency and operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%."（transcript.txt）

**关键观察**：这是唯一下滑的分部，但毛利率逆势提升（Activision 摊销减少）。下滑主要来自 Xbox（内容与服务的同比高基数）和 Windows OEM（PC 需求疲软 + Win10 支持终止高基数）。经营费用因共享研发投入和 Xbox 减值而增长，叠加收入下滑，导致经营利润双位数下滑。

---

## 六、全公司合计数与分部勾稽验证

### 6.1 验证表（$M）

| 指标 | PBP | IC | MPC | 分部合计 | 公司合计（披露） | 差异 | 是否一致 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 37,847 | 39,306 | 12,854 | 90,007 | 90,007 | 0 | ✅ 一致 |
| Cost of Revenue | 6,989 | 16,876 | 5,660 | 29,525 | 29,525 | 0 | ✅ 一致 |
| Operating Expenses | 8,958 | 6,475 | 4,446 | 19,879 | 19,879 | 0 | ✅ 一致 |
| Operating Income | 21,900 | 15,955 | 2,748 | 40,603 | 40,603 | 0 | ✅ 一致 |

**数据出处**：financial_statements.txt → Segment Results 工作表（Total 行）与 press_release.txt（Segment Revenue Constant Currency Reconciliation 表）。三者加总与公司披露合计**完全一致**，无差异。

### 6.2 汇总对比表（完整分部对比）

| 指标（$M） | PBP | Intelligent Cloud | MPC | 公司合计 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **FY26 Q4 Revenue** | 37,847 | 39,306 | 12,854 | 90,007 |
| FY25 Q4 Revenue | 33,112 | 29,878 | 13,451 | 76,441 |
| Revenue YoY | +14.3% | +31.6% | −4.4% | +17.7% |
| Revenue CC YoY | +14% | +31% | −5% | +17% |
| **FY26 Q4 Cost of Revenue** | 6,989 | 16,876 | 5,660 | 29,525 |
| FY25 Q4 Cost of Revenue | 6,042 | 11,845 | 6,127 | 24,014 |
| COGS YoY | +15.7% | +42.5% | −7.6% | +22.9% |
| **FY26 Q4 Gross Margin %** | 81.5% | 57.1% | 56.0% | 67.2% |
| FY25 Q4 Gross Margin % | 81.8% | 60.4% | 54.4% | 68.6% |
| GM pp 变化 | −0.2pp | −3.3pp | +1.5pp | −1.4pp |
| **FY26 Q4 Operating Expenses** | 8,958 | 6,475 | 4,446 | 19,879 |
| FY25 Q4 Operating Expenses | 8,077 | 5,893 | 4,134 | 18,104 |
| OpEx YoY | +10.9% | +9.9% | +7.5% | +9.8% |
| **FY26 Q4 Operating Income** | 21,900 | 15,955 | 2,748 | 40,603 |
| FY25 Q4 Operating Income | 18,993 | 12,140 | 3,190 | 34,323 |
| OI YoY | +15.3% | +31.4% | −13.9% | +18.3% |
| **FY26 Q4 Operating Margin** | 57.9% | 40.6% | 21.4% | 45.1% |
| FY25 Q4 Operating Margin | 57.4% | 40.6% | 23.7% | 44.9% |
| OM pp 变化 | +0.5pp | ~0pp | −2.3pp | +0.2pp |
| 收入占比 | 42.0% | 43.7% | 14.3% | 100% |
| 利润占比 | 53.9% | 39.3% | 6.8% | 100% |

---

## 七、关键结论与交叉验证

1. **Intelligent Cloud 是增长主引擎**：收入 +31.6%（+$9.4B），Azure +43%，经营利润 +31.4%。公司整体 17.7% 的收入增速中，Intelligent Cloud 贡献了约 12.3 个百分点。
2. **Productivity and Business Processes 稳健增长**：收入 +14.3%，经营利润率最高（57.9%）且继续小幅扩张（+0.5pp），Copilot 付费席位超 3000 万（Satya Nadella，transcript.txt 第 16000 字符）是关键驱动力。
3. **More Personal Computing 是唯一下滑分部**：收入 −4.4%，经营利润 −13.9%，主要受 Xbox 高基数和 Windows OEM 需求疲软拖累。但毛利率因 Activision 摊销减少而逆势提升 1.5pp。
4. **毛利率结构性下移**：公司整体毛利率从 68.6% 降至 67.2%（−1.4pp），主因是收入结构向 Azure（毛利率较低）倾斜以及 AI 基础设施投入。这是管理层在电话会中明确指出的结构性因素，而非短期波动。
5. **经营杠杆仍在**：尽管毛利率下降，但经营费用增速（+9.8%）低于收入增速（+17.7%），经营利润率小幅扩张 0.2pp 至 45.1%。
6. **跨分部指标 Microsoft Cloud 收入 $59.3B（+27%）**，商业 RPO $678B（+84%），为未来收入提供强劲可见性。

**重要提示**：Microsoft Cloud 收入（$59.3B）包含了跨分部的 M365 Commercial（属 PBP）、Azure（属 IC）、Dynamics 365（属 PBP）及 LinkedIn 商业部分（属 PBP）等，**不能与三个分部简单相加**，否则会重复计算。这是读者使用这些数字时最需要注意的口径问题。
